notes: History means use the latest 20 or full model-visible training interactions. Recommendations are identical for both reference windows; validation/test events are excluded.
Each known-year movie has equal weight. Missing years are excluded from means and decade shares; counts are shown. A newer mean is not proof of lower accuracy or satisfaction.
The catalog reference weights each eligible unseen movie equally. The popularity reference takes the same number of movies with the largest training interaction counts (ties by movie ID).
Genre filters select users by their dominant historical genre, including all ties; they do not restrict recommendations to that genre or remove confounding.
Newer means a later release year within this historical dataset, not a recent release today. Rating histories include disliked movies and do not necessarily represent viewing order.
